description.sub_name: 從電影中的文化反思看性別多元議題
description.sub_ename: CULTURAL AWARENESS REGARDING GENDER AND SEXUALITY IN FILMS
description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在引導學生討論當今男女性別刻板印象和性別少數族群(LGBTQ)所面臨的挑戰與課題。 學生會定期在課堂中以小組合作的方式分析在教學引導時所介紹的國際和本土電影與其相關文獻探討，分享個人的看法，並以反省或批判的態度將這些看法和意見與自己在臺灣所見所聞做連結，在達成跨文化溝通之餘，思考如何在台灣創造性別多元和友善的文化意識與環境
description.describe_eh: This course aims to generate discussion and cultural awareness of some of the key gender and LGBTQ issues debated in today’s society. It will prompt students to develop critical thinking about the traditional gender roles imposed on people and create alternative views regarding gender performances and a variety of sexualities. Students will be expected to work in groups to analyze the pivotal topics demonstrated by the international and Taiwanese films shown in the class, share their insights with their fellow classmates and relate their points to what they have seen in Taiwan.

  2. Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism.抄襲：必須適當引用來源。未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。
  3. Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating.考試作弊：必須遵守考試規則，禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。

courseBankC.describe_ch: 學生能藉由上課中的文化議題訓練語言溝通技巧
courseBankC.describe_en: Students can apply English communicative skills by discussing different cultural topics
courseBankC.core_item: 批判思考:能從不同角度探索問題、且能客觀分析、整合資訊，理性評估，並做出合理判斷。
courseBankC.core_eng: Critical Thinking: Able to explore different issues from multiple perspectives, analyze, synthesize, and evaluate information in a rational manner, and make reasonable judgements.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 學生能團隊合作完成課堂中文化和語言相關的作業或專題
courseBankC.describe_en: Students can apply collaborative skills and critical thinking to complete language and culture related assignments
